bio:
Looks like sonic except for his black and white colors and the lack of a nose and a mouth
Story: 12-year-old boy who had achromatopsia died and possesed sonic in a sonic 2 cartridge, turned everything into monocrhomatic tones, has a chance of taking over other games.
